hints.title: Per-Table Storage Model
hints.text: Maintain an internal mapping of tables where each table tracks its own auto-incrementing row id and row data.

hints.title: Row Storage Indexing
hints.text: For each table, map integer row ids to string arrays representing the row columns.

hints.title: Column Indexing Conversion
hints.text: Note that column ids in the select operation are 1-indexed, so convert columnId to columnId - 1 when accessing the row array.

hints.title: In-Memory Table Storage Implementation

variables: total inserted cells: cumulative count of stored string values
complexity.notes: Hash map operations provide O(1) row insertions, deletions, and cell queries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Sequential array scans for row lookups yield O(number of rows) overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash map index per table trades pointer overhead for instant row retrieval.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Clean separation of table state with auto-increment counter and constant-time row lookup.
